buzzRounds.topic: White Sox one win from the league championship series
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The White Sox beat the Guardians 4-3 in Cleveland on Monday to take a 2-0 lead in their American League Division Series. Braden Montgomery hit a two-run double in the sixth inning for the go-ahead runs, and Sean Burke won it with 5 1/3 innings of relief.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Chicago lost a post-1900 record 121 games in 2024 and is the first team to reach the postseason after three straight 100-loss seasons. One more win sends it to the American League Championship Series for the first time since 2005, the year it won the World Series.

buzzRounds.topic: Padres avoid elimination on a wild final play
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Facing elimination, the Padres beat the Brewers 4-3 in San Diego on Tuesday. Jake Cronenworth hit the tiebreaking homer in the fifth, and with two runners on in the ninth, Xander Bogaerts fielded Christian Yelich's 107 miles per hour line drive on a short hop on his knees, stepped on second and threw to first for a game-ending double play.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Milwaukee still leads the National League Division Series 2-1, and Game 4 is Wednesday in San Diego.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The Padres were one loss from going home and beat the Brewers 4-3 on Tuesday, and it ended when Xander Bogaerts fielded a 107 miles per hour line drive on his knees and turned a game-ending double play. Milwaukee still leads the series 2-1.

details.name: Xander Bogaerts

details.buzz: Bogaerts singled and scored the Padres' fourth run on a hustle play in the sixth, then ended Game 3 with a double play on Christian Yelich's 107 miles per hour liner.

buzzRounds.topic: Skubal wins first playoff start for the Dodgers
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Tarik Skubal, whom Detroit traded to the Dodgers just before the August 3 trade deadline, allowed one run on two hits in six innings as the Dodgers beat the Braves 5-3 in Game 1 of the National League Division Series on Saturday.
